description: Frozen per-track metric baselines for scoring regression detection. 2026-09-28: re-frozen on the SAME golden recordings after the lateral-error scoring frame moved from the lookahead reference point (ref_x, 3.7-7.2 m ahead) to the Unity at-car road-frame cross-track (T-METRIC-LATERAL-ERROR-FRAME; scoring_registry.LATERAL_ERROR_SCORING_FRAME).
